nodes.description: Public state variable holding the rebase schedule start timestamp, set in the constructor from block.timestamp.
Public state variable, default 86400, length of one supply epoch used to index the supply lists.
RebasableContract handle for the ORBI token, target of external rebase() calls.
RebasableContract handle for twin0, target of external rebase() calls.
RebasableContract handle for twin1, target of external rebase() calls.
SyncableContract handle for the twin0 liquidity pool, target of external sync() calls.
SyncableContract handle for the twin1 liquidity pool, target of external sync() calls.
SyncableContract handle for the ORBI liquidity pool, target of external sync() calls.
Public address of the ORBI token contract.
Public address of the twin0 token contract.
Public address of the twin1 token contract.
Public address of the ORBI liquidity contract.
Public address of the twin0 liquidity contract.
Public address of the twin1 liquidity contract.
Public state variable holding the privileged owner address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and mutable via changeOwner.
Cached last-known ORBI total supply used to compute the rebase delta.
Cached last-known twin0 total supply used to compute the rebase delta.
Cached last-known twin1 total supply used to compute the rebase delta.
Public array of 14 target twin supply values indexed by the time-derived epoch slot.
Public array of 14 target ORBI supply values indexed by the time-derived epoch slot.
onlyOwner modifier that requires owner == msg.sender; the sole access-control gate for privileged functions.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender and initializing initTime from block.timestamp.
Owner-only function that forwards two supply deltas to the twin token contracts via external rebase() calls.
Owner-only function that forwards a supply delta to the ORBI token contract via an external rebase() call.
Owner-only function that transfers ownership to an arbitrary new address.
Owner-only function that overwrites the orbiSupplyList array.
Owner-only function that overwrites the twinSupplyList array.
Owner-only one-time initializer for the twin token and liquidity contract handles, guarded by zero-address checks.
Owner-only one-time initializer for the ORBI token and liquidity contract handles, guarded by a zero-address check.
Permissionless function that reads block.timestamp, selects target supplies, performs external rebase()/sync() calls and updates cached supply totals.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment and the onlyOwner check.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (now) used to derive initTime and to select the supply epoch index.
External call twin0Contract.rebase(supplyDelta0) in rebaseTwins; callee can re-enter.
External call twin1Contract.rebase(supplyDelta1) in rebaseTwins; callee can re-enter.
External call orbiContract.rebase(supplyDelta) in rebaseOrbi; callee can re-enter.
External call twin0Contract.rebase(delta) inside rebase() before the cached twin0SupplyTotal is updated.
External call twin1Contract.rebase(delta) inside rebase() before the cached twin1SupplyTotal is updated.
External call orbiContract.rebase(delta) inside rebase() before the cached orbiSupplyTotal is updated.
External call twin0LiqContract.sync() triggered on negative twin0 delta, both from the twin branch and the unguarded orbi branch.
External call twin1LiqContract.sync() triggered on negative twin1 delta, both from the twin branch and the unguarded orbi branch.
External call orbiLiqContract.sync() triggered on negative ORBI delta inside rebase().
Arithmetic derivation (now - initTime) / secondsPerSupplyBlock % 14 used to index the supply lists; time dependent.
Signed integer arithmetic int(newSupply) - int(supplyTotal) plus the < 0 comparisons that decide whether sync() is executed.
First supply delta argument of rebaseTwins.
Second supply delta argument of rebaseTwins.
Supply delta argument of rebaseOrbi.
New owner address argument of changeOwner.
Replacement array argument of changeOrbiSupplyList.
Replacement array argument of changeTwinSupplyList.
twin0 token address argument of setTwins.
twin1 token address argument of setTwins.
twin0 liquidity address argument of setTwins.
twin1 liquidity address argument of setTwins.
ORBI token address argument of setOrbi.
ORBI liquidity address argument of setOrbi.
Local variable holding the twin0 target supply read from twinSupplyList.
Local variable holding the twin1 target supply read from twinSupplyList with a +7 slot offset.
Local variable holding the ORBI target supply read from orbiSupplyList.
Boolean flag tracking whether twin0LiqContract.sync() was already executed.
Boolean flag tracking whether twin1LiqContract.sync() was already executed.

edges.reason: The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of rebaseTwins.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of rebaseOrbi.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of changeOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of changeOrbiSupplyList.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of changeTwinSupplyList.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setTwins.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of setOrbi.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier; forged callers revert.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor.
msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to establish the initial privileged owner.
initTime is derived from block.timestamp, making the schedule miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp feeds the epoch index arithmetic (now - initTime) / secondsPerSupplyBlock.
The timestamp-derived index selects an element of twinSupplyList, so supply values are time dependent.
The timestamp-derived index selects an element of orbiSupplyList, so supply values are time dependent.
twin0NewSupply is read from twinSupplyList at the computed epoch slot.
twin1NewSupply is read from twinSupplyList at the offset epoch slot.
orbiNewSupply is read from orbiSupplyList at the computed epoch slot.
twin0NewSupply participates in the signed delta subtraction int(twin0NewSupply) - int(twin0SupplyTotal).
twin1NewSupply participates in the signed delta subtraction int(twin1NewSupply) - int(twin1SupplyTotal).
orbiNewSupply participates in the signed delta subtraction int(orbiNewSupply) - int(orbiSupplyTotal).
twin0SupplyTotal is subtracted from the new twin0 supply to form the rebase delta.
twin1SupplyTotal is subtracted from the new twin1 supply to form the rebase delta.
orbiSupplyTotal is subtracted from the new ORBI supply to form the rebase delta.
The computed twin0 delta is passed as the argument of the external twin0Contract.rebase call.
The computed twin1 delta is passed as the argument of the external twin1Contract.rebase call.
The computed ORBI delta is passed as the argument of the external orbiContract.rebase call.
twin0SupplyTotal is updated to twin0NewSupply after the external call executes.
twin1SupplyTotal is updated to twin1NewSupply after the external call executes.
orbiSupplyTotal is updated to orbiNewSupply after the external call executes.
twin0Contract state variable supplies the callee address for the rebase external call.
twin1Contract state variable supplies the callee address for the rebase external call.
orbiContract state variable supplies the callee address for the rebase external call.
twin0LiqContract state variable supplies the callee address for the sync external call.
twin1LiqContract state variable supplies the callee address for the sync external call.
orbiLiqContract state variable supplies the callee address for the sync external call.
A negative twin0 delta enters the branch that performs the twin0LiqContract.sync external call.
A negative twin1 delta enters the branch that performs the twin1LiqContract.sync external call.
A negative ORBI delta enters the branch that performs the orbiLiqContract.sync external call.
twin0Synced guards whether twin0LiqContract.sync() is repeated in the ORBI branch.
twin1Synced guards whether twin1LiqContract.sync() is repeated in the ORBI branch.
Executing twin0LiqContract.sync() sets the twin0Synced flag to true.
Executing twin1LiqContract.sync() sets the twin1Synced flag to true.
twin0Contract.rebase is an external call made before twin0SupplyTotal is updated, allowing the callee to re-enter rebase().
twin1Contract.rebase is an external call made before twin1SupplyTotal is updated, allowing the callee to re-enter rebase().
orbiContract.rebase is an external call made before orbiSupplyTotal is updated, allowing the callee to re-enter rebase().
twin0LiqContract.sync() is an unguarded external call that can re-enter the permissionless rebase().
twin1LiqContract.sync() is an unguarded external call that can re-enter the permissionless rebase().
orbiLiqContract.sync() is an unguarded external call that can re-enter the permissionless rebase().
The external twin0Contract.rebase call can call back into the owner-only rebaseTwins flow.
The external twin1Contract.rebase call can call back into the owner-only rebaseTwins flow.
The external orbiContract.rebase call can call back into the owner-only rebaseOrbi flow.
twin0Contract supplies the callee address for the twin0 rebase call in rebaseTwins.
twin1Contract supplies the callee address for the twin1 rebase call in rebaseTwins.
orbiContract supplies the callee address for the rebase call in rebaseOrbi.
Caller-supplied supplyDelta0 is forwarded to twin0Contract.rebase.
Caller-supplied supplyDelta1 is forwarded to twin1Contract.rebase.
Caller-supplied supplyDelta is forwarded to orbiContract.rebase.
Owner-only changeOwner writes the caller-supplied newOwner into the owner state variable.
Owner-only changeOrbiSupplyList replaces the entire orbiSupplyList with caller-supplied data.
Owner-only changeTwinSupplyList replaces the entire twinSupplyList with caller-supplied data.
twin0Addr is stored into the twin0Address state variable.
twin0Addr is cast into the twin0Contract RebasableContract handle.
twin1Addr is stored into the twin1Address state variable.
twin1Addr is cast into the twin1Contract RebasableContract handle.
twin0LiqAddr is stored into the twin0LiqAddress state variable.
twin0LiqAddr is cast into the twin0LiqContract SyncableContract handle.
twin1LiqAddr is stored into the twin1LiqAddress state variable.
twin1LiqAddr is cast into the twin1LiqContract SyncableContract handle.
orbiAddr is stored into the orbiAddress state variable.
orbiAddr is cast into the orbiContract RebasableContract handle.
orbiLiqAddr is stored into the orbiLiqAddress state variable.
orbiLiqAddr is cast into the orbiLiqContract SyncableContract handle.
The permissionless rebase() relies on block.timestamp to choose which supply values are applied.
